# Find HG38 SNP positions using biomart

```{r}
#Read in Malagasy data
bim_file1 <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Madagascar_full.bim")
           , header = FALSE, col.names = c("chromosome", "snp_id", "genetic_dist", "physical_pos", "allele1", "allele2"))
as.data.frame(bim_file1)


```

Removing SNPs with VG identifiers from .bim file 
Creating a data frame to track number of SNPs at each stage

```{r}

clean_bim=dplyr::anti_join(bim_file1,filtered_bim_VG_id)
```

```{r}

```

Find our SNPs in biomart

```{r}
#Chunking data to avoid timeout issues with ensembl getBM
snps=clean_bim[,2]
chunk=split(snps, ceiling(seq_along(snps)/50000))

#Find biomart entries for all our SNPs
get_and_combine_data <- function(chunk, mart) {
  result_df <- data.frame() 
  
  for (i in 1:length(chunk)) {
    data <- chunk[[i]]
    snp_data <- getBM(attributes = c("refsnp_id", "chr_name", "chrom_start", "allele_1", "allele","minor_allele","chrom_strand"),
                      filters = "snp_filter", values = data, mart = mart)
    
    result_df <- rbind(result_df, snp_data) 
    
    cat("Chunk", i, "complete.\n")
  }
  
  return(result_df)
}

biomart_result=get_and_combine_data(chunk,snpmart)
colnames(biomart_result)[1] <- "snp_id"
colnames(biomart_result)[4] <- "ancestral_allele"

```

#Update our Malagasy data to HG38 using biomart result

Removes patch entries from the biomart data.
Removes SNPs in our data that aren't in biomart output/weren't updated by biomart

Merges the biomart and Malagasy data into one dataframe by SNP ID

Selects SNP position and chr from biomart data, and all other columns from the Malagasy data
Removes NA entries
Removes entries where Allele A/B is entered as 0
Tests for completeness of the data
Saves as Madagascar_full_HG38.bim



```{r}

#Patch entries (all start with H)
biomart_pos_H=biomart_result[grepl("H", biomart_result[,2]),]
cat("Number of SNPs affected by patched entries:", nrow(biomart_pos_H),"\n")
cat("Number of unique patches covering SNPs:",length(unique(biomart_pos_H[,2])),"\n")

tracking_SNP_number <- rbind(tracking_SNP_number,c("Biomart output: increase due to patch entries",nrow(biomart_result),NA))

#Removing these patch entries
biomart_no_patches=dplyr::anti_join(biomart_result,biomart_pos_H)
cat("Number of SNPs in biomart output after removing patch entries:", nrow(biomart_no_patches),"\n")
tracking_SNP_number <- rbind(tracking_SNP_number,c("Removing patches",nrow(biomart_no_patches),sum(nrow(biomart_result)-nrow(biomart_no_patches))))

#Missing entries: removing SNPs without biomart position 
missing_total=clean_bim[!(clean_bim$snp_id %in% biomart_no_patches$snp_id),]
cat("Number of SNPs missing in biomart output:",nrow(missing_total),"\n")
clean_bim <- dplyr::anti_join(clean_bim,missing_total, by = "snp_id")


#Merge our 'clean .bim' with the biomart output with updated positions
new_bim=dplyr::left_join(clean_bim,biomart_no_patches, by = "snp_id")

#Removing NA entries and writing new .bim
sum(is.na(new_bim$chrom_start))
new_bim=new_bim[,c(7,2:3,8,5:6)]

new_bim_no_NA <- na.omit(new_bim)
```

# Create a new binary fileset of Malagasy data

This set is reduced: no ambiguous SNPs, all SNPs will have an updated position in biomart file.

```{r}

#New Madagascar binary fileset
system("plink --bfile C:/Users/eviec/Git/malagasy_diversity/data/raw/data_input/Madagascar_full --extract C:/Users/eviec/Git/malagasy_diversity/data/intermediate/biomart/Madagascar_full_HG38_snps --make-bed --out C:/Users/eviec/Git/malagasy_diversity/data/intermediate/biomart/data-merge-corrected/Madagascar_full_extracted")

#Read in
new_data <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/biomart/data-merge-corrected/Madagascar_full_extracted.bim"))

#Order of snps in input
new_data_snp_order <- as.data.frame(new_data$V2)

#Update positions
data_pipeline_bim <- function(x, y) {
  # where x is new data to convert to HG38 positions
  # and y is the current dataset e.g., updated Malagasy biomart positions
  
  # Read in the data
  new_data <- x
  colnames(new_data) <- c("chromosome", "snp_id", "genetic_dist", "physical_pos", "allele1", "allele2")
  comparative_data <- y 
  colnames(comparative_data) <- c("chromosome", "snp_id", "genetic_dist", "physical_pos", "allele1", "allele2")
  
  
  # Find overlap between SNPs in each set
  # Overlap should be obsolete in new version of data merge
  overlap <- sum(new_data$snp_id %in% comparative_data$snp_id)
  cat("Supplied .bim contains",nrow(new_data), "SNPs", "\n")
  cat(overlap,"SNPs overlap with our dataset","\n")
  
  # Exit at this point if overlap is less than 200,000
  if (overlap < 200000) {
    warning("Less than 200,000 overlapping SNPs found.")
    return(new_data)
  }
  
  # Find matching SNP IDs
  match_indices <- match(new_data$snp_id, comparative_data$snp_id)
  
  # Identify rows with matches and update physical_pos
  matching_rows <- !is.na(match_indices)
  new_data$physical_pos[matching_rows] <- comparative_data$physical_pos[match_indices[matching_rows]]
  new_data$chromosome[matching_rows] <- comparative_data$chromosome[match_indices[matching_rows]]
  
  # Non-overlapping rows are not updated
  # These remain in the output, will be removed in plink 
  
  return(new_data)
}


new_data <- data_pipeline_bim(new_data,new_bim_no_NA)

#Check order of snps is preserved 
new_data_output_order <- as.data.frame(new_data$snp_id)
all(new_data_output_order == new_data_snp_order)== TRUE


#Save out
#write.table(file=resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/biomart/data-merge-corrected/Madagascar_full_extracted.bim"), new_data, sep="\t",row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
```


# Flipping new dataset strands to match ours

Updating other data .bim files so SNPs match our strand


```{r}
flip <- function(x, y) {
  # where x is new data to convert to our strands
  # and y is the current dataset e.g., updated Malagasy biomart positions
  
  # Read in the data
  new_data <- x
  colnames(new_data) <- c("chromosome", "snp_id", "genetic_dist", "physical_pos", "allele1", "allele2")
  comparative_data <- y 
  colnames(comparative_data) <- c("chromosome", "snp_id", "genetic_dist", "physical_pos", "allele1", "allele2")
  
  # Find overlap between SNPs in each set
  overlap <- sum(x$snp_id %in% y$snp_id)
  cat("Supplied .bim contains",nrow(x), "SNPs", "\n")
  cat(overlap,"SNPs overlap with our dataset","\n")
  
  # Find matching SNP IDs
  match_indices <- match(x$snp_id, y$snp_id)
  
  # Identify matching rows
  matching_rows <- !is.na(match_indices)
  
  # Remove non-matching rows
  x_overlapping <- x[matching_rows, ]
  
  
  df <- dplyr::left_join(x_overlapping, y, by = "snp_id")
  colnames(df) <- c("chromosome", "snp_id", "genetic_dist", "physical_pos", "allele1", "allele2","chromosome.2", "genetic_dist.2", "physical_pos.2","ref1","ref2")
  

  # Create list of ambiguous SNPs 
  ambiguous <- subset(df, df$allele1 == "A" & df$allele2 == "T" |
                        df$allele1 == "T" & df$allele2 == "A" |
                        df$allele1 == "G" & df$allele2 == "C" |
                        df$allele1 == "C" & df$allele2 == "G")
  cat(nrow(ambiguous), ": ambiguous SNPs", "\n")
  cat(overlap - nrow(ambiguous), ": SNPs to process", "\n")
  
  #Remove ambiguous SNPs 
  #df <- dplyr::anti_join(df,ambiguous)
  #cat(nrow(df),": left after removing ambiguous SNPs", "\n")
  
  #Function to find complementary bases
  complement_base <- function(base) {
    switch(base,
           A = "T",
           T = "A",
           C = "G",
           G = "C",
           base  
    )
  }
  
  #Function to find opposite
  opposite_base <- function(base) {
    switch(base,
           A = "G",
           G = "A",
           C = "T",
           T = "C",
           base  
    )
  }
  
  
  # Rename cases where allele 1 or 2 is missing, using our data
  rename_new_data <- function(row){
    if(!(row["allele1"] %in% c("A", "T", "C", "G")) & row["allele2"] == row["ref2"]){
      row["allele1"] <- row["ref1"]
      return(row)
    }
    else if(!(row["allele2"] %in% c("A", "T", "C", "G")) & row["allele1"] == row["ref1"]){
      row["allele2"] <- row["ref2"]
      return(row)
    }
    else if(!(row["allele1"] %in% c("A", "T", "C", "G")) & row["allele2"] == row["ref1"]){
      row["allele1"] <- row["ref2"]
      return(row)
    }
    else if(!(row["allele2"] %in% c("A", "T", "C", "G")) & row["allele1"] == row["ref2"]){
      row["allele2"] <- row["ref1"]
      return(row)
    }
    else if(row["allele1"]==complement_base(row["ref1"]) & !row["allele2"]%in% c("A", "T", "C", "G")){
      row["allele2"] <- complement_base(row["ref2"])
      return(row)
    }
    else if(row["allele2"]==complement_base(row["ref2"]) & !(row["allele1"]%in% c("A", "T", "C", "G"))){
      row["allele1"] <- complement_base(row["ref1"])
      return(row)
    }
    else if(row["allele1"]==complement_base(row["ref2"]) & !(row["allele2"]%in% c("A", "T", "C", "G"))){
      row["allele2"] <- complement_base(row["ref1"])
      return(row)
    }
    else if(row["allele2"]==complement_base(row["ref1"]) & !(row["allele1"]%in% c("A", "T", "C", "G"))){
      row["allele1"] <- complement_base(row["ref2"])
      return(row)
    }
    else{
      return(row)
    }
  }
  
  renamed <- apply(df, MARGIN = 1, rename_new_data)
  renamed <- t(renamed)
  cat("renamed new data","\n")
  renamed <- as.data.frame(renamed)
  #print(str(renamed))
  colnames(renamed) <- c("chromosome", "snp_id", "genetic_dist", "physical_pos", "allele1", "allele2","chromosome.2", "genetic_dist.2", "physical_pos.2","ref1","ref2")

  
  
  #Finding same strand (matching) and those to flip (flipped_condition) after renaming
  process_row <- function(row) {
    
    #Same strand - matching ancestral, minor, allele1, allele2 
    matching <- (row["allele1"] == row["ref1"] & row["allele2"] == row["ref2"] | row["allele1"] == row["ref2"] & row["allele2"] == row["ref1"])
    
    #Opposite strand - matching ancestral, minor, allele1, allele2
    flipped_condition_allele1_ref1 <- (row["allele1"] == complement_base(row["ref1"]) & row["allele2"] == complement_base(row["ref2"]))
    flipped_condition_allele1_ref2 <- (row["allele1"] == complement_base(row["ref2"]) & row["allele2"] == complement_base(row["ref1"]))
    
   
    if(matching) {
      return(c(row, type = "matching"))
    } else if (flipped_condition_allele1_ref1 | flipped_condition_allele1_ref2) {
      row["allele1"] <- complement(row["allele1"]) #row["ref1"]
      row["allele2"] <- complement(row["allele2"]) #row["ref2"] 
      return(c(row, type = "flipped"))
    #} else if (flipped_condition_allele1_ref2){
    #  row["allele1"] <- #row["ref2"]
    #  row["allele2"] <- #row["ref1"]
    #  return(c(row, type = "flipped"))
    } 
      else {
      return(c(row,type = "?"))
    }
  }
  
  processed_rows <- apply(renamed, 1, process_row)
  processed_rows <- t(processed_rows)
  
  processed_rows <- as.data.frame(processed_rows,colnames=c("snp_id","chr_name","chrom_start","updated_allele_a","allele","updated_allele_B","chrom_strand","genetic_dist","allele1","allele2","type"))
  
  cat("Processing finished", "\n")
  matching_both_ways <- processed_rows[processed_rows$type == "matching", ]
  flipped_rows <- processed_rows[processed_rows$type == "flipped", ]
  cat(nrow(flipped_rows),": SNPs flipped","\n")
  to_remove <- processed_rows[processed_rows$type == "?", ]
  cat(nrow(to_remove),": SNPs to exclude?","\n")
  
  #Create a list of removed snps
  to_remove_list <- to_remove$snp_id
  cat(nrow(processed_rows),": Processed","\n")
  
  #Leave SNPs to remove and ambiguous in output, create a list of these to remove in plink if necessary
  
  #output <- dplyr::anti_join(processed_rows,to_remove)
  #output <- dplyr::anti_join(processed_rows,flipped_rows)
  
  output <-processed_rows[,1:6]
  snps <- processed_rows[,2]
  
  return(list(output,renamed,processed_rows,to_remove,snps))
}


some_flips <- flip(new_data, new_bim_no_NA) 


```

Ambiguous and non-overlapping SNPs currently removed at this stage

Triallelic SNPs that cannot be flipped also removed (examined in output [[4]])

Output [[1]] is an updated .bim file where all SNPs that overlap with our dataset will have positions updated to HG38 and strand consistency with our data.

Output [[5]] is a list of these snps

Output [[4]] is a list of snps that are either triallelic or ambiguous in the new dataset
